gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-fahkwang: Chunky, compass-drawn letters with gaps in the e up top. Fahkwang is the one with a faint nib-pressure wobble, its round letters finishing their curves before they close.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-figtree: Figtree looks marker-drawn, its e leaving a wide gap at the terminal. Happy Monkey feels louder and more rigid beside it, while Figtree keeps a modern, easygoing hum.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-finlandica: Happy Monkey draws every line with a ruler-straight weight, and its e leaves wide gaps. Finlandica follows with a constant-width outline and open crossbar mouths, so the sans text feels clean under that bold top.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-fustat:
Fustat bends its lines like tubing, with c endings left wide open.

Happy Monkey earns its keep big and brief, where its bold, distinctive character gets room, while Fustat's plain sans shapes carry the rest.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-gantari: A ruler-straight line weight runs through Happy Monkey, gaps open in every e. Gantari feels wire-bent and approachable beneath it, with wide c apertures softening the heading's bold, distinctive stance.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-gayathri: Flat, marker-bold headings with a pen that never shifts pressure. Gayathri, a plain sans with mild thick-thin variation like a letterpress slug, would read at an approachable, smoothed pace through a whole page.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-google-sans: Google Sans reads smooth, with no thick-thin shift and terminals pulled well back. Happy Monkey brings the bold, distinctive punch on top, and the plain sans below it keeps everything contemporary and approachable.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-gothic-a1: Approachable, with a bold streak up top. Happy Monkey holds a marker-nib line that ignores direction, so Gothic A1 is best left at a modest size, its splayed c terminal doing quiet work.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-gotu: Happy Monkey hums along at a flat, constant line weight, with wide gaps in the e. But Gotu is the plain sans that eases terminals and joins slightly in weight, with sturdy hairlines and open crossbar mouths for its clean text.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-gowun-dodum: Bold and blunt on top, Happy Monkey draws ruler-straight lines with wide gaps in the e. Gowun Dodum softens it with a smooth, tube-like line.
